description: Port Fairy Seawall in Place Hazard Lines is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. The Port Fairy Local Coastal Hazard Assessment (LCHA) provides information on the extent of coastal hazards and their physical impacts for the Port Fairy coastal environment. This data considers setback of the present day shoreline due to coastal erosion if existing seawall (where present) remains in place. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are  atmosphere,  meteorology, Climatology, Environment, Geoscientific information. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
